validity.researcher_notes: Critical discrepancy: EIA Natural Gas Pipeline Projects workbooks (all releases from Jul 2019 onward) show this project as 'Completed' effective 2019-09-03. First appeared as 'Part Completed' in Jul 2019 release (date 2019-07-03), then 'Completed' (date 2019-09-03) in Oct 2019 release and all subsequent releases through Aug 2026. Sheet currently records Status='cancelled', CancelledYear=2021. EIA data progression: Aug 2018 'Applied' → Jan-May 2019 'Construction' → Jul 2019 'Part Completed' (2019-07-03) → Oct 2019 onward 'Completed' (2019-09-03). Project moved to Historical Projects section starting Jan 2020. The recording of status='cancelled' appears to be an error; the pipeline was completed and entered service in 2019. Requires FERC order verification to confirm whether project was completed or whether a subsequent withdrawal order exists that contradicts EIA. [ORCHESTRATOR AUDIT 2026-09-15] Tier corrected high/independent=True -> medium/independent=False: this record's proposed_refs resolve to 1 distinct publisher(s) (eia.gov), and rule 4 counts publishers, not URLs — every EIA release is ONE origin. The FINDING is unchanged; only the confidence claim was wrong.

status_reviews.segment_name: Rivervale South to Market Expansion Project

verifications.note: name matched: 'Rivervale South to Market Project' / operator 'Transcontinental Gas Pipeline', sheet 'Natural Gas Pipeline Projects', Excel row 128

status_reviews.researcher_notes: EIA data provides strong evidence of status change. Oct 2019 release first shows project as 'Completed' as of 2019-09-03. Project progressed from 'Applied' (Aug 2018) → 'Construction' (Jan 2019) → 'Part Completed' (Jul 2019, date 2019-07-03) → 'Completed' (Oct 2019, date 2019-09-03). All subsequent releases (through May 2026) maintain 'Completed' status in Historical Projects tab. Current sheet status 'cancelled' appears erroneous. Proposed status change: 'cancelled' → 'operating' with StartYear=2019. No evidence of a subsequent cancellation after completion. Verdict: CHANGE from the sheet's current (incorrect) cancelled status to operating status based on completion in 2019. ORCHESTRATOR CORRECTION 2026-09-14: CONFIRMED in the main loop and the proposed changes were INCOMPLETE as first staged -- flipping Status to 'operating' while leaving CancelledYear='2021' and ShelvedCancelledType='inferred' in place would ship a row that is operating and cancelled at once, so both are now cleared explicitly. The sheet's own ShelvedCancelledType is 'inferred', i.e. nobody ever sourced a cancellation -- it was DEDUCED from dormancy. That is the whole defect: the project went into service on 2019-09-03 and simply stopped generating news, and the silence was read as cancellation in 2021. EIA Aug 2026, sheet 'Historical Projects (1996-2024)', Excel row 967: 'Rivervale South to Market Project', Transcontinental Gas Pipeline, FERC docket CP17-490, NJ to NJ, 0.61 miles, 190 MMcf/d additional capacity, Completed 2019-09-03. Note that 0.61 mi = 0.98 km, which matches the sheet's LengthKnown of 0.98 km EXACTLY, and 190 MMcf/d matches the recorded capacity exactly -- the row's own numbers are the completed project's numbers, which is further evidence the cancellation is the error and not the data. | ORCHESTRATOR 2026-09-14: tier demoted to medium and independent -> false. Rule 4 sets `high`/independent at 2+ INDEPENDENT origins; this record's verified refs resolve to 1 publisher(s) (eia.gov). All EIA releases are ONE origin. | ORCHESTRATOR 2026-09-14 CANCELLATION-FIELD CLEARING (slice-wide sweep 7(b), same ruling as P4070). A row cannot carry a live Status and a cancellation/shelving date at the same time: that pairing is the defect class this sweep exists to find, and it would misreport this project in every downstream count. Sheet carries ShelvedYear=2019, CancelledYear=2021 and ShelvedCancelledType='inferred'; the prior pass cleared only the latter two and MISSED ShelvedYear. All three are now cleared in proposed_changes. EIA's dated progression (Applied Aug2018 -> Construction Jan2019 -> Part Completed Jul2019 -> Completed 2019-09-03, held through every release to May2026) is a completion record, and no FERC withdrawal order was found to support a 2021 cancellation.
